rules.statement: This save establishes that after the yacht outing, V and Kerry agreed on the beach to continue their relationship.
This save establishes that after the yacht outing, V told Kerry it was a one-off rather than the beginning of an ongoing relationship.
For the planned Samurai reunion, this save establishes that V selected Denny when Denny and Henry refused to play together. That choice does not establish that the concert has taken place.
For the planned Samurai reunion, this save establishes that V selected Henry when Denny and Henry refused to play together. That choice does not establish that the concert has taken place.
This save establishes that V and Kerry shared a kiss on the Dark Matter terrace. The kiss alone does not establish an ongoing relationship.
This save establishes that the backstage confrontation ended with Kerry and V pressuring Us Cracks to cancel the show and abandon the cover, rather than reconciling.
This save establishes that the backstage confrontation ended in reconciliation: Kerry accepted Us Cracks after the manager-driven misunderstanding came to light.
The Samurai reunion concert has taken place in this save, with V on stage alongside Kerry and the reunion musicians, including Nancy.
In this save, Denny performed in the completed Samurai reunion that Nancy helped organize.
In this save, Henry performed in the completed Samurai reunion that Nancy helped organize.
In this save's assault on Arasaka with Rogue, Adam Smasher killed Rogue during the confrontation before Mikoshi. Johnny witnessed her sacrifice while controlling V's body.
This save establishes that during the Ebunike confrontation, V chose to lower the weapon and spare Grayson.
This save establishes that Grayson was killed during V's confrontation with him at the Ebunike.
The drive-in outing with Rogue has concluded in this save. Johnny attended using V's body, and control returned to V afterward.

During the completed drive-in outing, Johnny and Rogue began an intimate moment, but Rogue stopped it and explained that she could not return to their old relationship. Johnny was using V's body; this was not a V/Rogue partnership.
